blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla on Wednesday urged Philippine government officials to speak with Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan in person. Padilla recently described Jing as “educated, gentlemanly, and straightforward” after they spoke on Monday at the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations-Chinese Business Leaders Summit. READ: Robin Padilla chats with ‘gentleman’ Chinese ambassador Philippine Coast Guard spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela, in a television interview, asked what basis Padilla had for describing the Chinese envoy as such. “What is my basis?
